games.name: Build to Survive Drakobloxxers: Rescripted
games.desc:
RECODE IS COMING SOON! 
What to expect?
* Christmas (December 1 - January 6) & Anniversary (July 22) events
* New brick colors (randomized and season based)
* New BTools
* Classic Drakobloxxer variant exclusive to Anniversary
* Shiny Drakobloxxers spawning outside of April (depending on worn hats)
* Command UI
* "The Adversary" easter egg tweaks
* New Badges
* Access for every age group!
...and many more!

== Known Problems ==
* Build Tools won't work nicely on mobile and the bricks might not replicate.

A FilteringEnabled port of a classic 08-11 game by papasmurf, which was a great part of my early Roblox days and has over 6 million visits. 
The game will stay faithful to the original. The only things added were optional sounds, optional music, badges and also quality of life additions.

Left Click - Punch
1, 2, 3, 4 - Use Skills

F - Block
G - Activate Awakening
B - Open Emote Wheel

Down Slam - Jump + Left Click
